summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $500,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Leveraged Barrier Notes due October 3, 2031, linked to the State Street Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLU), issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. Notes price at $1,000 each, pay no interest, carry a 175.00% participation rate, a $1,200 call payment on the September 30, 2027 observation date, a 75% threshold value of $29.58 versus the $39.44 initial value, and full downside principal exposure. This is a routine structured-note shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms apply beyond the security's own economics.
